summary: Adds one column after the last column that holds data.
description: The values fill the column downwards: one value per row. A sheet is examined whole and the column is written from row 1; a range is examined only inside itself and the column is written on its rows, right of the last column of the range that holds data.
It is `appendColumns` with one column: the same guards, the same growth of the sheet when the result would not fit, and the same rule that a cell whose text starts with `=` becomes a formula.

params.target: The sheet to append to, or the range to append within.
params.values: A single column: a flat array, one value per row.
params.options: `afterFrozenColumns` starts the write past the frozen columns when the data ends before them.

returns: the sheet, so calls can be chained.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is neither a sheet nor a range.
throws.TypeError: the values are not a flat array.
